chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Dixieland typecasting and playing in different styles
summary: Dickenson says he was typecast as a Dixieland player but likes any good music and feels at home in a new style within a couple of days.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
